pages.text: Turns $(l)organic waste$() into $(l)Biogas$(). It needs no power: just feed it.$(br)$(li)Accepts $(l)anything a composter takes$() (seeds, crops, leaves, saplings, flowers...) and $(l)rotten flesh$().

$(li)Each item takes 2 seconds. A sure-fire compost item (like a cake) gives $(l)250 mB$(), the others less, in proportion to their composting chance; rotten flesh gives $(l)200 mB$().$(br)$(li)Holds $(l)8,000 mB$() and pushes the gas into adjacent $(l:cables/gas_pipe)Gas Pipes$(/l), tanks or a $(l:generators/gas_turbine)Gas Turbine$(/l).
A Harvester drone and a hopper feeding the digester make a fully automatic biogas farm.
